about_the_game:
Inquisitor Shepherd

Step into the role of an Inquisitor in "Inquisitor Shepherd," a visual novel mystery thriller.

As Inquisitor Shepherd, you'll be sent to a remote village in the religious nation of Vucrium to investigate a burgeoning heresy case and uncover the dark secrets it holds. Through dialogue and investigation, you must gather information, interrogate heretics, and decide their ultimate fate. But be warned: the path ahead is filled with dread and chaos. Don't let your guard down.

Every choice you make directly impacts the ending, with multiple distinct outcomes awaiting you.

Investigate and Judge a World of Fear

Converse with Suspects

The core of this mystery revolves around 15 unique characters. Each person holds their own secrets and stories, some offering help while others present a direct threat. You must engage with them in conversation to gather information, find evidence, and piece together the truth.

Search and Gather Evidence

During your investigation, you'll need to meticulously search specific locations. Examine objects to find clues and information, and solve puzzles to advance the story.

You can also use Inquisitor Shepherd's special ability, 'Sin Powder.' This sacred power heightens your senses, allowing you to uncover information that would otherwise be hidden or break through a tough interrogation.

Interrogate and Judge Heretics

As an Inquisitor, you'll use all the information and evidence you've gathered to interrogate the heretics. You must see through their lies and deception, or, in some cases, clear the name of an innocent person to reveal the true culprit. Your final verdict — Guilty or Innocent — will determine their destiny and completely alter the course of the narrative.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains psychological horror, realistic depictions of extreme violence and gore, and criminal acts, and may not be suitable for some users.

Additionally, it includes brightly flashing images which may cause discomfort and seizures in those with photosensitive epilepsy.

Player discretion is advised.
